summary: First full test run of KeyQuest typing site. Backend FastAPI (10 games) and React frontend validated end-to-end. 15/15 pytest cases pass. Playwright flow for register, login, logout, wrong-password error, speed-test completion with save, dashboard stats, leaderboard, and 9 of 10 games sampled. Theme toggle, 3D keyboard, hero typing animation, /games filters (All/Classic/Arcade), mobile layout all verified. All functional targets met.

minor.issue: CORS_ORIGINS="*" combined with allow_credentials=True violates CORS spec; browsers may silently drop cookie auth from a different-origin frontend. Works today only because frontend uses Bearer token (localStorage). Recommend setting explicit origin to the deployed frontend URL.
Cookies set with secure=true, samesite=none, but CORS_ORIGINS="*" means credentialed cookie flow won't actually work cross-origin per spec.

issues: Looks clean. Dark neon default and light-mode toggle both render correctly; mobile 390px layout is intact with no overflow.

action_items: (Optional) Replace CORS_ORIGINS="*" with the explicit frontend origin to make the httpOnly-cookie auth path spec-compliant. Bearer-token auth works regardless.
No functional fixes required for the listed features.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: `CORS_ORIGINS="*"` + `allow_credentials=True` is invalid per CORS spec; works only because frontend sends Authorization header, not cookies.
server.py: Admin password hash is rewritten on every startup if changed in .env (good: idempotent seed). Bcrypt hash format verified ($2b$).
server.py: `GAME_IDS` list in backend duplicates frontend list — consider sharing or returning via /api/games to keep both in sync.

server.py: Login lockout logic ok (5 fails, 15 min). Minor: lockout window keeps resetting `last` on each new failure after reaching 5, extending the ban indefinitely under sustained attack — acceptable behavior, worth documenting.

GamePlay.jsx: `useEffect` for Enter-to-start listens to window keydown on every re-render; dependency array is correct but the start callback resets `run`, which can cause brief double-mount — minor, not blocking.
test_credentials: Admin: admin@keyquest.com / admin123 (seeded on startup). Also created ad-hoc test_ui_<rand>@keyquest.com / test1234 during tests.
seed_data_creation: Backend seeds admin on startup. Tests created ~12 Result docs for admin and ~1 new TEST_ user with 10 game results. Non-destructive.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend endpoints: /api/auth/{register,login,logout,me}, /api/results (POST, GET /me), /api/stats/me, /api/leaderboard?game_id=. GAME_IDS = 10 games listed in server.py. Email is lowercased on register/login. Word-target game elements use exact data-testid values 'falling-word', 'zombie', 'asteroid' (NOT suffixed). Char-typer games listen to window keydown; word-target games use data-testid='game-word-input'. Enter on 'ready' or 'over' screens triggers start. CORS is a known minor issue if testing cookie-only auth.
